generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The Bidder Shall Quote Rates Excluding GST Only.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending Bidder shall have successfully carried out similar work of Supply, installation, testing & commissioning of network signal booster in any utility in India in any Central or State Govt. or PSUs or any reputed private organizations. In this regard, the intending bidder shall have successfully carried out the said work as Prime Contractor in a single Work done of value not less than Rs.01.76 Lakhs in Central or State Govt. or PSUs or any reputed private organizations in last preceding five financial year (Financial Year 2021-22 to 2025-26) and shall furnish copy of the related Work order and Work done certificate issued by the competent authority as documentary evidence. Cost of completed works of previous years will be given 10 percent of simple weightage per year to bring them to current year price level.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Copy of the related Work order and Work done certificate issued by the competent authority as documentary evidence.

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder in his name shall have achieved in at least two financial years an average annual turnover of Rs.03.52 Lakhs in the last preceding five years (i.e., Financial Year 2021-22 to 2025-26) and furnish annual turnover certificate OR Profit & Loss statements duly certified by the Chartered Accountant. Financial Turnover of previous years will be given 10 percent of simple weightage per year to bring them to current year price level.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Annual turnover certificate OR Profit & Loss statements duly certified by the Chartered Accountant.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Registration of Establishment or firm or company or individual from Govt. authority, Department of Labour, if registered.
PF Registration with Regional Provident Fund Commissioner OR declaration as per Annexure-VII.

Declaration by the bidder that none of his contracts have been terminated/foreclosed by KPCL or elsewhere on account of his default during the last 3 years shall be furnished as per the format enclosed/Attached electronically Refer Annexure-I.
My offer has no conditions contravening the commercial conditions of the bid Refer Annexure-II.

The bidder had studied the site conditions, labour conditions, special conditions and read the tender document and related matters carefully and diligently, and that I have submitted the tender having studied, understood and accepted fully the implications for the agreement as per the format enclosed/Attached electronically Refer Annexure-III.
Schedule of General Particulars Refer Annexure-IV.
Declaration on quoted price exclusive of GST. Refer Annexure-V.
If PF registration is not available, The self-declaration on stamp paper shall be uploaded. Refer Annexure -VII.
